Body.Content: Azure Mobile Engagement is a SaaS-delivered, data-driven, user-engagement platform that enables real-time and fine-grain user segmentation, app-user analytics, and context-aware, smart-push notifications across all connected devices. You can maximize your app usage, retention, and monetization with this powerful platform. It allows developers, app owners, and line-of-business decision makers to directly contact app users in a personal, context-aware, and nonintrusive way. Comprehensive analytics go beyond typical key performance indicators, highlighting the data to capture, track, analyze, and act on for improving engagement when customers need your products or services. For more information, please visit the Mobile Engagement page.
Body.Markdown:
Azure Mobile Engagement is a SaaS-delivered, data-driven, user-engagement platform that enables real-time and fine-grain user segmentation, app-user analytics, and context-aware, smart-push notifications across all connected devices.

You can maximize your app usage, retention, and monetization with this powerful platform. It allows developers, app owners, and line-of-business decision makers to directly contact app users in a personal, context-aware, and nonintrusive way.

Comprehensive analytics go beyond typical key performance indicators, highlighting the data to capture, track, analyze, and act on for improving engagement when customers need your products or services. For more information, please visit the Mobile Engagement page.
